evidence: In the local Marimo app with base_url=/my/custom/path, the LSP websocket upgrade to /my/custom/path/lsp/pylsp was rejected with HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden, while the same handshake to /lsp/pylsp returned HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols.
steps: Installed the local codebase in an isolated virtual environment with `bash setup_env.sh`.
Started a minimal Marimo Starlette app with `base_url=/my/custom/path` and a mocked pylsp proxy.
Probed websocket handshakes with curl; the prefixed path was rejected and the root path upgraded successfully.
